claim_one_line: LISTENING 27, THE BLIND RE-LISTEN COMPARED WITH THE RECORD (PROVED for its checks; data-free): of a blind listener's twenty observations four were on the record (B1989's five finite orbits found again independently), six sharpen it, eight are new and two split; main checked the new ones that decide: the four-move sum is 3(SP + PS) - 2S on every orbit, so its spectrum pairs lambda with lambda + 2 by the two-subspace theorem (exact on five orbits, modulo three primes at mod 135): a law of the modular group, not of the whole; the 6-point dihedral orbit on every leaf k = t^2 (B1989's owed family); the point-count rule p^2 + p(3 chi(k - 4) + chi(k(k - 4))) + 1; residues 3 mod 4 and 3, 6 mod 9 never attained and 15 locally solvable leaves without a point to 3000; two equal 2-adic halves on k = 5, 13, 29 at 2^5 to 2^7; the mod-5 cusp orbit is the icosahedral 40-orbit reduced; and the halving holds at 54, 108, 162 but fails at 189 as at 135, so its failure at mixed levels is not the icosahedral origin
